trigger: 4ec444ad0's persister wait_for_pass used a plain 5ms-poll stoppable_wait, looser interleaving fidelity between persist and prune than the pre-4153 real-SQLite version's blocking wait had
summary: a std::stop_callback-bridged design was tried to restore genuine blocking-wait semantics while adding stoppability (built, passed 5x normal runs) but empirically hung for the full 60s under a pruner-suppression mutation: std::atomic<T>::wait(old) re-compares against `old` on every wakeup and re-blocks if the value has not actually changed, so a stop_callback's notify_all() with no real value change is silently absorbed. Root-caused live via /proc/<pid>/task/*/wchan during the hang. Reverted to the git-committed working state; fixed instead in 6826ec47d by giving stoppable_wait an optional poll-interval parameter (default 5ms, matching the pagers test) and passing 50us for the persister specifically, narrowing the fidelity gap without the atomic::wait/notify trap. Removed the now-dead pruner_passes.notify_all() call with an explanatory comment. Verified two-sided: pruner-suppression mutation -> exit 42 at exactly 30s, clean attributed FAIL, no hang; slow-pruner mutation -> 6.08s runtime, exit 0.
